name: visual-qa
title: Visual QA
description: Render at desktop, tablet and mobile, capture screenshots, detect visual problems (navigation, hero, typography, spacing, CTAs, cards, forms, animation, 3D, footer, overflow), send issues back, re-render and compare until quality gates pass or the cycle limit is reached.
when_to_use: After every build or significant change - one of the most important ApexWeb skills.
instructions: Use the visual_qa region checks and screenshots as ground truth; name viewport, region and element for each issue.
Compare with the previous pass: report resolved issues, remaining issues and regressions.
Approve only when no critical or major visual issue remains.
